board.intro: Customers comment {code} on your Facebook / TikTok live or post, or send it on WhatsApp — orders are created and stock is reserved automatically.
board.noSessionHint: Comments still create orders — a session just groups them for the board and reports.
board.emptyText: Give products a short code (A01, A02…) so customers can order by comment.
board.waiting: Waiting for comments… try the simulator above.

orders.emptyText: Orders appear here when customers comment product codes.

order.waitingAddress: Waiting for {name} to confirm their address. Reserved until {date}.
order.notified: The customer was messaged about this update.
order.notifyFailed: Couldn't message the customer ({error}). Send them the order link yourself.

channels.needVerifyToken: set {env} in the API .env to enable Facebook/WhatsApp webhooks.
channels.needAppSecret: Set {env} so webhook signatures are verified.
channels.needHttps: Webhooks must reach your API over public HTTPS (e.g. a domain or a tunnel like Cloudflare Tunnel / ngrok while testing).
channels.tokenStored: Stored on the server and never shown again.

facebook.title: Facebook Page (posts, lives & Messenger)
facebook.idHelp: Facebook → your Page → About → Page transparency → Page ID
facebook.tokenHelp: Page access token with pages_manage_engagement, pages_read_user_content and pages_messaging
facebook.s1: Create a Meta app (developers.facebook.com) and add the Webhooks + Messenger products.
facebook.s2: Webhooks → Page: callback URL below, verify token = META_VERIFY_TOKEN from the API .env. Subscribe to “feed” and “messages”.
facebook.s3: Set META_APP_SECRET in the API .env so every webhook is signature-checked.
facebook.s4: Paste the Page ID and a long-lived Page access token here.

whatsapp.title: WhatsApp Business (Cloud API)
whatsapp.idHelp: WhatsApp Manager → API setup → Phone number ID (not the phone number itself)
whatsapp.s1: In your Meta app add the WhatsApp product and connect your business number.
whatsapp.s2: Webhooks → WhatsApp Business Account: same callback URL and verify token as Facebook. Subscribe to “messages”.
whatsapp.s3: Paste the Phone number ID and a permanent system-user token here.
whatsapp.s4: Customers message your WhatsApp number, e.g. “ສັ່ງ A01 2”. Replies go out as WhatsApp messages (within the 24-hour service window).

tiktok.title: TikTok (LIVE / video comments)
tiktok.idHelp: Your TikTok account open_id from the TikTok developer portal
tiktok.tokenHelp: Not needed — TikTok has no public API for replying to LIVE comments
tiktok.s1: TikTok only exposes LIVE comments to approved partners (TikTok Shop / LIVE partner programmes). If you have access, point its webhook at the TikTok URL below and set TIKTOK_CLIENT_SECRET.
tiktok.s2: Otherwise use a comment relay tool (or an n8n workflow) that forwards comments to a “Webhook” channel — see below.
tiktok.s3: Customers see their checkout link when you read it on stream or pin it; replies can’t be posted automatically.

webhook.title: Webhook (n8n, Make, Zapier, LINE bot, custom)
webhook.s1: POST JSON to the ingest URL with an HMAC-SHA256 signature of the raw body using this channel’s secret.
webhook.s2: The response contains reply_text and checkout_url — post them back to the customer from your workflow.

settings.requireTrigger: Only accept comments that include a trigger word
settings.requireTriggerHint: Recommended for busy lives. When off, “{example}” also orders — but questions like “{question}” are always ignored.
settings.paymentInstructions: Payment instructions (shown on the checkout page)
